dogecoin.text:
Elon Musk, CEO and founder of American electric car company #Tesla, has disclosed that he plans to start a social network that would support the dog-themed cryptocurrency #Dogecoin (DOGE).

Shark Tank star Mark Cuban has thought of a way to solve Twitter's spam problem using the meme cryptocurrency dogecoin (DOGE). Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk agrees that it is "not a bad idea." Twitter recently accepted Musk's buyout offer.
